title: Codex Session Sync
description: Automatically save Codex conversations to SiYuan notes

setting.parentPathDesc: Parent path for session documents (under your notebook root)
setting.pathTemplateDesc: Template for new document paths. Variables: ${parentPath}, ${date}, ${projectName}, ${title}, ${sessionId}
setting.headerTemplateDesc: Template for new document header. Variables: ${projectName}, ${date}, ${time}, ${sessionId}
setting.includeProjectPatternsDesc: One rule per line. Empty means allow all projects; supports plain substrings and * wildcards.
setting.excludeProjectPatternsDesc: One rule per line. A match always skips sync; supports plain substrings and * wildcards.
setting.excludeContentPatternsDesc: One rule per line. Remove a message part when part.text or part.input matches; supports plain substrings and * wildcards.
setting.notebookDesc: Select the notebook to save session documents
setting.syncModeDesc: Control what content is saved for each Codex turn
setting.syncModeClassic: Classic: user input + final Codex output
setting.siyuanPortDesc: Port of the SiYuan instance to connect to (default: 6806)
setting.codexHooksPathDesc: Codex Stop hook will be installed to ~/.codex/hooks.json
setting.testSuccess: ✅ Connection successful! SiYuan API is reachable.
setting.resetTemplatesDesc: Reset message and header templates to defaults
setting.hookInstalledMsg: Codex hook installed successfully! Takes effect on next Codex session.
